This page lists 120 Adobe Lightroom Classic keyboard shortcuts for macOS, grouped by area. They come from the community `lightroom-classic.keyly` template for [Keyly](/), a free, open-source menu bar app: install the template once, then double-tap `⇪ Caps Lock` in Adobe Lightroom Classic to see them next to the shortcuts Keyly reads from the app's menus.

## Install the template

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/hoaiphongdev/keyly/main/scripts/install-templates.sh | bash -s -- -t lightroom-classic.keyly
```

This saves the template to `~/.config/keyly/templates/lightroom-classic.keyly`. It targets `/Applications/Adobe Lightroom Classic/Adobe Lightroom Classic.app`; if Adobe Lightroom Classic lives elsewhere on your Mac, [update the app path](/configuration/templates/). New to Keyly? Start with [Getting Started](/getting-started/).

## Panels

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⇥` | Show/Hide side panels |
| `⇧⇥` | Show/Hide all panels |
| `T` | Show/Hide toolbar |
| `F5` | Show/Hide Module Picker |
| `F6` | Show/Hide Filmstrip |
| `F7` | Show/Hide left panels |
| `F8` | Show/Hide right panels |
| `⌘Z` | Undo |
| `⌘⇧Z` | Redo |

## Modules

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `⌥⌘1` | Library module |
| `⌥⌘2` | Develop module |
| `⌥⌘3` | Map module |
| `⌥⌘4` | Book module |
| `⌥⌘5` | Slideshow module |
| `⌥⌘6` | Print module |
| `⌥⌘7` | Web module |
| `⌥⌘←` | Go back |
| `⌥⌘→` | Go forward |

| Shortcut | Action |
| --- | --- |
| `1-5` | Set star rating |
| `0` | Remove rating |
| `]` | Increase rating |
| `[` | Decrease rating |
| `6` | Red label |
| `7` | Yellow label |
| `8` | Green label |
| `9` | Blue label |
| `P` | Flag as pick |
| `X` | Flag as reject |
| `U` | Unflag |
| `\` | Show/Hide Filter bar |
